premise.claim: Dependabot: the mooncake e2e image's pinned aiohttp 3.14.3 is superseded by aiohttp 3.14.4 (features + ~20 bug fixes, incl. HTTP/WebSocket parser hardening).
premise.reportedComponent: test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image/requirements.txt (hash-locked pip deps of the mooncake e2e helper image)
premise.evidence: base requirements.txt pins aiohttp==3.14.3; 3.14.4 exists on PyPI (release notes fetched from github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp tag v3.14.4). See results/base-control-unit.status.

findings.title: aiohttp 3.14.4 requires yarl>=1.25.1 but the lock still pins yarl==1.24.5, so the mooncake e2e image build fails (all 5 kind-e2e matrix jobs red)

liveNote: No live/KUBECONFIG layer for this PR: the change is a pip lock file for a test image, not controller code. The integration layer (pip download with the Dockerfile's exact flags for cp312/manylinux x86_64) is the closest faithful replica of the docker build; the authoritative end-to-end signal is the kind-e2e workflow itself, whose failure log is captured in results/ci-kind-e2e-failure-excerpt.txt.
